# Sun: a disc of horizontal strips, solid at the top, cut by widening gaps below (a setting sun),
# tilted back 40 degrees to face the camera. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sun --base-color 0.9333 0.1412 0.2392 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name S0 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.810
scale 1.043 0.120 0.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.530
scale 1.627 0.120 0.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S2 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.250
scale 1.883 0.120 0.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S3 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.010
scale 1.950 0.120 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S4 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.370
scale 1.800 0.120 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S5 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.730
scale 1.266 0.120 0.120
apply --scale
select S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5
active S0
join
rename S0 Sun
material assign Sun
set rotation -40 0 0
apply --rotation
shade flat
export sun.glb
